title: Derived World Loop Reconstruction

loop_order.name: Accept/collect user input
loop_order.host_evidence: Session status CR_TERMINATED_STRING_AVAILABLE leads to STTROU in MBBSEmu host loop.

loop_order.name: Process global commands
loop_order.host_evidence: Internal and module global command handlers are checked before in-module state dispatch.

loop_order.name: Enter/login/module transition routines
loop_order.host_evidence: EnteringModule, LoginRoutines, and RloginEnteringModule state handlers invoke entry/login routines.

loop_order.name: Optional per-channel polling
loop_order.host_evidence: BEGIN_POLLING routine runs if registered for the session.

loop_order.name: Process timed/global events
loop_order.host_evidence: Host processes RTKICK, RTIHDLR, SYSCYC, INITASK after sessions.

loop_order.name: Dequeue pending statuses
loop_order.host_evidence: Host dequeues remaining status entries at loop end.

loop_order.name: Output visible to modem/client
loop_order.host_evidence: Implied by session output state and host/session design; exact flush boundary still requires source/runtime trace.

major_mud_projection: Movement/combat/quest commands likely enter through STTROU or equivalent in-module command routine.
Regeneration, AI, spawn, poison, disease, and other periodic systems likely depend on TICKER/RTKICK/STSROU/SYSCYC-style host callbacks rather than client simulation.
Player output is a result of module-owned state changes and host session flushing, not local client prediction.
